DeviceVisit.title: DeviceVisit
DeviceVisit.description: Records visit statistics, hardware metadata, and optional student visitor profile for a specific device.

deviceId.description: Unique persistent device identifier generated on the client.

visitCount.description: Number of times this device has opened the application.

deviceType.description: Device category such as mobile, tablet, or desktop.

os.description: Operating system of the client device.

browser.description: Browser family used to access the application.

firstVisitAt.description: ISO timestamp of the first recorded visit.

lastVisitAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent visit.

age.description: Age of the student or visitor.

schoolName.description: Name of the school the student belongs to.

isRegistered.description: Whether the visitor submitted their student information.

registeredAt.description: ISO timestamp when the student profile was submitted.

VisitorProfile.title: VisitorProfile
VisitorProfile.description: Public directory entry of registered student visitors.

visitCount.description: Total visits recorded for this student.

isPublic.description: Flag enabling visibility in the student directory.

GlobalStats.title: GlobalStats
GlobalStats.description: Aggregated application-wide visit counters, registered students count, and device counts.

totalVisits.description: Total count of all app sessions recorded.

uniqueDevices.description: Total count of unique devices registered.

registeredStudentsCount.description: Total count of visitors who completed their profile registration.

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the last update.

/devices/{deviceId}.description: Stores individual device visit metrics and visitor profile data.

/visitors/{deviceId}.description: Stores registered student visitor profile for school directory.

/stats/visits.description: Stores global app visit, unique device counters, and registered students total.
